The core idea is to leverage the properties of elliptical slice sampling (ESS) in the latent space of these models, which are assumed to have a Gaussian source distribution. The authors demonstrate that by performing Bayesian inference directly in the source space, they can circumvent the need for backpropagation through the generative model.
